method: Zone areas are renormalised over the marked zones only; the unmarked interface band, 4.0 % of the mosaic, is excluded because the tow boundary is diffuse. Each zone's area share is then multiplied by its pooled in-zone fibre fraction.
note: Fractions are of the solid phases. Voids and cracks are located by threshold, not by the classifier, and are excluded from the denominator.
